caveat.before: Extensions are not added to every profile. They load only in Chromium profiles that have "Load SoftGlaze extensions (uses Chrome-for-Testing)" ticked on the profile editor's Advanced tab (off by default). Those profiles mount them with Chromium's
caveat.middle: flag at launch, so a change applies on the
caveat.after: of such a profile. Regular Chrome ignores that flag, so these profiles open on a Chrome for Testing build: download one on the Browsers page first, or the profile opens without the extensions. Firefox profiles do not load them.
